headline: 4 Michigan deals, $54.5M raised — led by Penstock Equity II LP

top_deals.summary: Penstock Equity II LP, a Birmingham-based private equity fund, disclosed a $50M raise; $41M sold to 79 investors.
Cipher Chain Partners, LP, a Birmingham-based hedge fund, disclosed an open-ended (indefinite) raise; $9.4M sold to 18 investors. (Amended filing.)
SC LH Holdings III, LLC, a Grand Rapids-based investment fund, disclosed a $3M raise; $2.2M sold to 9 investors.
Moksa.ai Inc., a Troy-based technology company, filed an indefinite-size equity offering under Rule 506(b); $1.8M sold to 3 investors.

talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $54.5M sold across 4 Form D filings this week, down 74% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was Moksa.ai Inc. (Troy, Other Technology) targeting $1.8M. Good question to ask: are founders in technology favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?

3 Michigan-based pooled funds filed Form Ds, reporting $52.7M raised so far — led by Penstock Equity II LP (Private Equity Fund). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?
Private Funds was the most active sector with 3 of 4 filings (75%). Ask contacts what's driving the activity, and whether it's showing up in their pipeline.
